title: Claude Code rate_limits Field for Statusline Scripts (v2.1.82)
description: New rate_limits field in statusline script data, providing 5-hour and 7-day usage windows with used_percentage and resets_at timestamps. Format: {rate_limits: {5h_used_percentage: N, 5h_resets_at: ISO, 7d_used_percentage: N, 7d_resets_at: ISO}}. Enables statusline scripts to display rate limit proximity warnings.
redundancy_comparison: Registry has 'rate_limits statusline field' as ACTIVE (v2.1.80+) with old format {hour5: {used: N, limit: N}, day7: {used: N, limit: N}}. The v2.1.82 format uses percentages and resets_at timestamps — more actionable and different schema. Registry format documentation is outdated and needs updating.

evaluation.reasoning: Not a new discovery — rate_limits statusline field was already integrated from v2.1.80. However, the format changed in v2.1.82: raw counts (hour5.used/limit) replaced by percentages + resets_at timestamps. The registry format documentation is now outdated. Approving as registry update only. Percentages are more directly actionable for threshold checks (>80% → warn). resets_at timestamps enable scheduling awareness. Zero integration cost for single-user setup.
evaluation.action: REGISTRY_UPDATE: Update Statusline System table in registry (v2.1.82 format: 5h_used_percentage, 5h_resets_at, 7d_used_percentage, 7d_resets_at). Update helpers/navigation/hook-environment-variables.md statusline section with new format and example snippets.
